injuries.longComment: Corley had not caught a pass across the first nine games of the campaign before hauling in three passes during Sunday's victory. He ended up finishing the contest third on the team in receiving yards behind Harold Fannin and Jerry Jeudy.

injuries.shortComment: Wallace caught both of his two targets for nine yards during Sunday's 27-24 win versus the Texans. He also recorded one tackle in kick coverage.
injuries.longComment: Wallace again played a rotational role in Week 10, logging 13 snaps at wide receiver. He was able to draw a season-high two targets and come down with both of them, making him one of eight Browns to catch a pass from quarterback Deshaun Watson Sunday. Barring an injury to one of the wideouts ahead of him on the depth chart, he doesn't have a clear path to more consistent playing time following Cleveland's bye in Week 11.

injuries.shortComment: out
injuries.longComment: out

injuries.shortComment: Szmyt made two of his three field-goal attempts and all three of his PATs in the Browns' 27-24 win over the Texans on Sunday.
injuries.longComment: Szmyt knocked through field goals from 49 and 26 yards in Sunday's contest. The kicker stumbled in the fourth quarter, missing a 54-yard attempt with 11:02 remaining that would've brought the game within a point. Szmyt is now 21-for-24 on field-goal attempts and 15-for-16 on PATs over 10 regular-season contests in 2026.

injuries.shortComment: McLaughlin was limited to one snap on offense and none on special teams in Sunday's 27-24 win over the Texans.
injuries.longComment: Since Week 7, McLaughlin has logged just three snaps on offense in the Browns' ensuing three games, but prior to Sunday, he still appeared to be in the mix for work on kickoff returns. However, Isaiah Bond and Malachi Corley have since taken over as the team's preferred kickoff returners, leaving McLaughlin without a role on special teams. McLaughlin will likely continue to see little use as Cleveland's No. 3 back behind Quinshon Judkins and Dylan Sampson.

injuries.shortComment: Sampson rushed four times for six yards and caught four of six targets for 31 yards in Sunday's 27-24 win over the Texans.
injuries.longComment: Sampson hardly carries the ball for Cleveland and is merely the pass-catching complement to Quinshon Judkins out of the backfield. Across five games this season, Sampson has rushed 19 times for 79  yards while adding 16 catches for 152 yards on 22 targets. He's playable in PPR fantasy leagues as a desperation RB2 option, particularly in games for which the Browns are projected to play from behind.

injuries.shortComment: Jeudy recorded two catches on four targets for 74 yards in a 27-24 victory over the Texans on Sunday.
injuries.longComment: Jeudy boosted his final line considerably on a 65-yard connection with Deshaun Watson in the second period. Watson carried the ball into the end zone on the following snap to bring the Browns to within seven points. Jeudy's 74 receiving yards were a season-high mark, though he finished with two or fewer receptions for the third straight week. The veteran wideout is behind both WRs Denzel Boston and KC Concepcion, not to mention tight end Harold Fannin, in the pass-catcher pecking order, so he may need to rely on big plays to have a chance to make an impact for fantasy managers.

injuries.shortComment: Concepcion caught three of eight targets for 21 yards in Sunday's 27-24 win over Houston. He also gained six yards on one carry.
injuries.longComment: Concepcion finished second on the Browns in targets behind tight end Harold Fannin, who had nine. However, whereas Fannin was able to turn his looks into seven receptions and 91 yards, Concepcion posted a much more modest 3-21-0 line. The rookie wideout departed to the medical tent during the first half of the game due to an undisclosed issue, but he was able to quickly return. Concepcion hasn't put up prolific numbers this season, but he does have at least three receptions in eight of his 10 appearances. Cleveland is on bye in Week 11, so Concepcion will next suit up Sunday, Nov. 29, against Las Vegas.

injuries.shortComment: Boston caught just one pass for 16 yards on two targets in Sunday's 27-24 win over the Texans.
injuries.longComment: The rookie wideout entered play Sunday dealing with a toe injury and appeared to aggravate it versus Houston. At less than 100 percent health, Boston was unproductive in the box score and saw a microscopic five percent target share. After popping back up for 6-98-0 receiving last Sunday in New Orleans with Shedeur Sanders at quarterback, Boston reverted to his sluggish ways with Deshaun Watson in Week 10. Over his last four games with Watson, Boston has compiled 11 catches for 95 empty yards. Boston can't be trusted in fantasy lineups until he shows more consistency.

injuries.shortComment: Watson completed 25 of 40 passes for 312 yards with no touchdowns and one interception while adding eight rushes for 49 yards and a score in the Browns' 27-24 win over the Texans on Sunday. He also committed a fumble that remained with Cleveland.
injuries.longComment: Watson helped the Browns overcome a 17-point first-half deficit, even though he didn't throw any touchdown passes for the fourth straight game. The veteran signal-caller did pile up the passing yardage against his old team, however, eclipsing 300 yards for the third straight game in the process. Watson also hit Harold Fannin with a critical 30-yard pass on his last pass attempt of the afternoon to set up Quinshon Judkins' game-winning rushing touchdown, and he'll next draw a highly favorable matchup against the Raiders in a Week 12 home matchup on Sunday, Nov. 29, following a Week 11 bye.

injuries.shortComment: Fannin brought in seven of nine targets for 91 yards in the Browns' 27-24 win over the Texans on Sunday.
injuries.longComment: Fannin led the Browns across the board in receptions, receiving yards and targets, and his 30-yard grab on Cleveland's penultimate possession set up Quinshon Judkins' game-winning five-yard touchdown rush on the next play. Fannin's chemistry with Deshaun Watson has been outstanding, and the second-year tight end now has at least 91 receiving yards in three of the past four games. Fannin will remain a central figure in Cleveland's impressive air attack when the team returns to action in a home matchup against the Raiders on Sunday, Nov. 29, following a Week 11 bye.

injuries.shortComment: Judkins rushed 10 times for 38 yards and a touchdown and brought in three of five targets for 33 yards in the Browns' 27-24 win over the Texans on Sunday.
injuries.longComment: Judkins' rushing volume was at a season-low level, but the second-year back managed to record his fourth rushing touchdown of the campaign on a five-yard run with just under a minute remaining. That proved to be the game-winning score, and Judkins also mustered his second-highest receiving yardage tally of the campaign. The 2025 first-round pick is averaging just 3.4 yards per carry, however, so he remains far from efficient heading into a Week 11 bye ahead of a Week 12 home matchup against the Raiders on Sunday, Nov. 29.

injuries.shortComment: Barnett (hamstring) has returned to Sunday's game against Houston, Scott Petrak of the Elyria Chronicle-Telegram reports.
injuries.longComment: Barnett left in the first quarter due to a hamstring injury, but the veteran defensive lineman was cleared by medical staff to return to Sunday's contest.

injuries.shortComment: The Browns placed Burton (calf) on injured reserve Saturday, Chris Easterling of the Akron Beacon Journal reports.
injuries.longComment: Burton was already ruled out for Sunday's game against the Texans due to a calf injury that he picked up against the Saints in Week 9. The injury is severe enough for him to warrant an extended absence, and since he's now on IR, Burton will be required to miss at least four games, so the earliest he can return is Week 15 against the Giants on Sunday, Dec. 20. Since the Browns do not have another fullback on the 53-man roster, the team will likely turn to tight ends Carsen Ryan, Zaire Mitchell-Paden and Blake Whiteheart to provide blocking out of the backfield, per Daniel Oyefusi of ESPN.com.

injuries.shortComment: Williams (hamstring) does not have an injury designation for Sunday's game against Houston.
injuries.longComment: Williams has had his practice reps over the last couple of weeks limited while tending to a hamstring injury, but he has yet to miss a regular-season game, and that trend will continue for Sunday's home tilt. The veteran linebacker has accumulated 62 tackles (37 solo), including 1.0 sacks, three pass defenses and four forced fumbles through nine regular-season games.

injuries.shortComment: Ward (quadriceps) does not have an injury designation for Sunday's game against the Texans.
injuries.longComment: Ward was managing a quad injury during all of Week 10 prep, but he avoided an injury tag for Sunday's game despite not logging a full practice. The veteran defensive back has 34 tackles (19 solo), nine pass defenses (including three interceptions) and two forced fumbles through nine regular-season games.

injuries.shortComment: Corbin was elevated from the Cowboys' practice squad to the active roster Saturday, Tommy Yarrish of the team's official site reports.
injuries.longComment: Corbin signed with the Cowboys' practice squad Nov. 4, and Saturday was his first elevation to the 53-man roster. With Tyler Goodson (knee) and Malik Davis (hip) both on injured reserve, Corbin will operate as Dallas' RB2 behind workhorse Javonte Williams. Corbin last saw regular-season action in 2023, when he appeared in six games as a member of the Giants.

injuries.shortComment: Thompson (hamstring) has been downgraded to out for Sunday's game against the Titans, Tommy Yarrish of the Cowboys' official site reports.
injuries.longComment: Thompson was a full participant in practice both Thursday and Friday, but the veteran safety is not quite ready to be activated from injured reserve. He'll end up missing an eighth consecutive game due to a hamstring injury he picked up in Week 3 against the Ravens. Thompson's next opportunity to play is Week 12 against the Eagles on Thanksgiving Day.

injuries.shortComment: The Cowboys placed Bland (ankle) on injured reserve Saturday, Tommy Yarrish of the team's official site reports.
injuries.longComment: Bland was expected to miss multiple games due to an ankle injury that he sustained in Week 10 against the 49ers. His placement on IR means he's required to miss at least four games, so the earliest he can return is Week 16 against the Jaguars on Sunday, Dec. 27. Ameer Speed and Cobie Durant are both in line for larger roles in Dallas' secondary in Bland's absence.

injuries.shortComment: Locke (concussion) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Titans, Tommy Yarrish of the Cowboys' official site reports.
injuries.longComment: Locke was unable to practice all week while in the league's concussion protocol, and his absence means Markquese Bell will likely start alongside Malik Hooker at safety Sunday. Locke's next chance to play is Week 12 against the Eagles on Thanksgiving Day.

injuries.shortComment: Ezeiruaku (ankle) does not have an injury designation for Sunday's game against the Titans, Tommy Yarrish of the Cowboys' official site reports.
injuries.longComment: Ezeiruaku didn't play against the 49ers in Week 10 due to an ankle injury. He's avoided an injury tag for Week 11 after logging a full practice Friday, and his return means less rotational snaps at the edge rusher position will be available for James Houston and Von Miller. Ezeiruaku has 32 tackles (16 solo), including 2.5 sacks, and one forced fumble across nine regular-season games.

injuries.shortComment: Schoonmaker (illness) is questionable for Sunday's game against the Titans, Tommy Yarrish of the Cowboys' official site reports.
injuries.longComment: Schoonmaker was held out of practice Thursday and Friday due to an illness, and he's drawn the questionable tag heading into the weekend. Jake Ferguson (knee) has already been ruled out, and with Schoonmaker under the weather, that leaves Brevyn Spann-Ford and James Mitchell as the Cowboys' two healthy tight ends on the 53-man roster ahead of Sunday's contest. Michael Trigg could be elevated from the practice squad to the active roster depending on Schoonmaker's recovery.

injuries.shortComment: Mingo (ankle/foot) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Titans, Tommy Yarrish of the Cowboys' official site reports.
injuries.longComment: It will be the second game that Mingo will miss while recovering from foot and ankle injuries, which have prevented him from practicing over the last two weeks, and his next chance to suit up is Week 12 against the Eagles on Thanksgiving Day. In Mingo's absence, KaVontae Turpin and Camden Brown will be the Cowboys' rotational options at wide receiver behind CeeDee Lamb, George Pickens and Ryan Flournoy.

injuries.shortComment: questionable
injuries.longComment: questionable

injuries.shortComment: Turpin is expected to resume return duties on both kickoffs and punts Sunday against the Titans, Calvin Watkins of The Dallas Morning News reports.
injuries.longComment: The wide receiver had to sit for three games with a rib injury before coming back for last Sunday's loss to the 49ers, in which he fielded punts but not kickoffs. Turpin has 574 kickoff-return yards and 108 punt-return yards on the year.

injuries.shortComment: Ferguson didn't practice Wednesday due to knee and ankle injuries and won't be available for Sunday's game against the Titans, Todd Archer of ESPN.com reports.
injuries.longComment: Ferguson injured his knee in a Week 9 win over the Colts, while the ankle issue is more of a lingering concern after he initially sustained a low sprain in a Week 8 loss to the Cardinals. Head coach Brian Schottenheimer previously announced Nov. 9 that Ferguson was set to miss multiple weeks, so the tight end's continued absence from practice comes as little surprise. In Ferguson's stead, Brevyn Spann-Ford should be in line for another turn as Dallas' top tight end in Week 11.

injuries.shortComment: Spann-Ford caught one of three targets for 26 yards during the Cowboys' 46-40 loss to the 49ers on Sunday.
injuries.longComment: Spann-Ford operated as the Cowboys' No. 1 tight end in Week 10 due to the absence of Jake Ferguson (knee). However, George Pickens, CeeDee Lamb and Ryan Flournoy were the top targets for Dak Prescott. Ferguson is expected to be sidelined for multiple weeks while recovering from his injury, so Spann-Ford should once again top the depth chart in Week 11 against a Titans team that has given up 40-plus points in each of its last two games.

injuries.shortComment: Aubrey made both of his field-goal attempts and went 2-for-3 on extra-point tries during the Cowboys' 46-40 loss to the 49ers on Sunday.
injuries.longComment: Aubrey connected on 52-yard field goals in both the first and third quarters, although his PAT in the second missed wide left. It was the second missed extra-point try of the season for Aubrey and his seventh miss overall, although five of those failed kicks have come on field-goal attempts from 50-plus yards. The Cowboys will stay home for Week 11 against the Titans, who give up 26.6 points per game (27th in the NFL) and have yielded 40-plus points in each of their last two contests.

injuries.shortComment: Abanikanda reverted to the Cowboys' practice squad Monday, per the NFL's transaction log.
injuries.longComment: Abanikanda made his 2026 regular-season debut against the 49ers in Week 10, when he operated as the Cowboys' RB2 behind Javonte Williams. Abanikanda finished that contest with two carries for eight yards and a two-yard catch on his lone target in what ended as a 46-40 loss for Dallas. With both Tyler Goodson (knee) and Malik Davis (hip) on injured reserve, Abanikanda figures to be elevated to the Cowboys' active roster for Week 11 against the Titans on Sunday.

injuries.shortComment: Booker suffered a high-ankle sprain in Sunday's 46-40 loss to the 49ers, Calvin Watkins of The Dallas Morning News  reports.
injuries.longComment: Booker is expected to miss multiple weeks after injuring his ankle in the first half of Sunday's game against the 49ers, per Jeremy Fowler of ESPN.com. The 22-year-old may be able to avoid being placed on injured reserve with the Cowboys' bye coming in Week 14. T.J. Bass will likely slot into Booker's right guard spot.

injuries.shortComment: Williams rushed 16 times for 63 yards and brought in his only target for four yards in the Cowboys' 46-40 loss to the 49ers on Sunday.
injuries.longComment: Williams had a near monopoly on the Cowboys' running back touches, but he worked hard for everything he got against a talented 49ers front seven. The veteran back averaged under 4.0 yards per carry for the seventh time this season, but he did eclipse 60 rushing yards for the third time in the last four games. Williams will take 692 rushing yards and nine rush TDs -- along with a 25-131-1 receiving line -- into a Week 11 home matchup against the Titans next Sunday.

injuries.shortComment: Lamb secured seven of 13 targets for 72 yards and a touchdown in the Cowboys' 46-40 loss to the 49ers on Sunday.
injuries.longComment: Despite his own impressive numbers, Lamb played second fiddle to George Pickens for a change, as the latter doubled up the former in receptions and did the same with a yard to spare in receiving yards. Nevertheless, Lamb still put together a solid performance that included his eighth touchdown reception of the season, a spectacular leaping one-handed one-yard grab late in the fourth quarter. Lamb now is up to five consecutive double-digit target tallies and has at least 70 receiving yards in four of the last five contests heading into a Week 11 home matchup against the vulnerable Titans defense.

injuries.shortComment: Prescott completed 30 of 51 passes for 343 yards with five touchdowns and one interception while rushing four times for seven yards in the Cowboys' 46-40 loss to the 49ers on Sunday. He also ran for a two-point conversion.
injuries.longComment: Playing catch-up from the second quarter on did wonders for Prescott's fantasy production, as the veteran quarterback sent 38 total targets in the direction of the talented trio of George Pickens, CeeDee Lamb and Ryan Flournoy alone. Prescott connected with Pickens for three of his scoring strikes, which went for 35, 39 and five yards. Flournoy (11 yards) and Lamb (one yard) accounted for the final two in the fourth quarter, and Prescott added a two-point conversion run after the final scoring toss with an admirable diving attempt on which he made contact with the pylon with the extended ball. Prescott tied a career high with his TD pass total, while his passing yardage was a season high. He should have an opportunity to put together a successful encore next Sunday, as a Week 11 home matchup with the vulnerable Titans secondary awaits.

injuries.shortComment: Pickens brought in 11 of 18 targets for 145 yards and three touchdowns in the Cowboys' 46-40 loss to the 49ers on Sunday.
injuries.longComment: After watching fellow wideout CeeDee Lamb have several monster performances through the first half of the season, Pickens stepped up and took his turn in his return from a one-game absence due to a hamstring injury. Pickens was peppered with targets from Dak Prescott all afternoon, and the star receiver finished with career-high reception and target totals and a season high in receiving yards. Pickens struck from 35, 39 and five yards out on his trio of scoring grabs, which constituted Dak Prescott's first three TD passes on the day. A now clearly healthy Pickens is up to a 50-678-5 line on 80 targets for the season heading into a Week 11 home matchup against the Titans next Sunday.

injuries.shortComment: Flournoy tallied six catches for 71 yards and one touchdown on seven targets during Sunday's loss to San Francisco. He also recovered a fumble.
injuries.longComment: Dallas played catch-up for much of the second half in the offensive slugfest, so quarterback Dak Prescott took to the air 51 times. Flournoy got seven of those targets, finishing third on the team behind George Pickens (18) and CeeDee Lamb (13). Flournoy's six receptions and 71 yards were both his second-highest figures so far this season, and the TD was his third in the past five weeks. That last stat in particular gives him relevance in most fantasy leagues, especially in matchups during which Prescott is expected to air it out often. The Cowboys will seek a much-needed win next Sunday at home against Tennessee.

injuries.shortComment: Ogbonnia (finger) has re-entered Sunday's matchup against San Francisco, Joe Hoyt of The Dallas Morning News reports.
injuries.longComment: Ogbonnia suffered a finger injury in the second quarter and was subsequently deemed questionable to return. However, he was able to get back on the field after halftime. Ogbonnia will thus continue to play a key role along Dallas' defensive line.

injuries.shortComment: Bullard (calf) is active for Sunday's game against the 49ers, Todd Archer of ESPN.com reports.
injuries.longComment: The Cowboys activated Bullard from injured reserve Saturday. The defensive tackle has been sidelined since sustaining a calf injury during the Cowboys' Week 3 loss to the Ravens. Bullard is set to suit up as a rotational defensive lineman behind starter Otito Ogbonnia.

injuries.shortComment: Porter (ankle) is active for Sunday's game against the 49ers, Todd Archer of ESPN.com reports.
injuries.longComment: Porter upgraded to limited participation in Friday's practice after missing the first two Week 10 prep sessions and the Cowboys' Week 9 win over the Colts. The cornerback is all set to return to the field alongside DaRon Bland to anchor the Cowboys' secondary for a big matchup with one of the NFC's top contenders.

injuries.shortComment: The Broncos elevated Schrader from their practice squad to their active roster Saturday, Susanna Weir of the team's official site reports.
injuries.longComment: Schrader's elevation is his third of the season, so he'll need to be signed to Denver's active roster in order to see game action for the team beyond Sunday. In his previous two appearances, the third-year pro played a total of two offensive snaps and nine snaps on special teams without recording any carries or targets. Schrader isn't likely to be much of a factor on offense Sunday against Las Vegas, as Jonah Coleman and J.K. Dobbins should continue to lead the Broncos' backfield. However, Schrader could contribute as a kick returner -- he's tallied 68 yards on three kickoff returns this season.

injuries.shortComment: The Broncos signed Rapp from the practice squad to the active roster Saturday, Zac Stevens of TheDNVR.com reports.
injuries.longComment: Rapp was cut from the Broncos' active roster in early November before opting to stick around as a member of the team's practice squad. His elevation gives Denver more depth in the secondary in the event that Brandon Jones (hamstring) cannot play against the Raiders on Sunday.

injuries.shortComment: Hufanga (ankle) does not have any injury designation ahead of Sunday's game against the Raiders, Aric DiLalla of the Broncos' official site reports.
injuries.longComment: Hufanga logged three consecutive full practices during Week 11 prep. The strong safety did not let his persistent ankle injury inhibit him during the week, clearing him of any injury designation that may have followed him into Sunday's contest.

injuries.shortComment: Lohner (foot) has been ruled out ahead of Sunday's game against the Raiders, Aric DiLalla of the Broncos' official site reports.
injuries.longComment: The Broncos opened Lohner's 21-day practice window Wednesday. The tight end is not quite ready to make his season debut, as he is still tending to his recovery from a foot injury he sustained in the offseason. Lohner was a full participant in all three Week 11 prep sessions, meaning his odds of returning in Week 12 are quite good if he can continue to log full sessions.

injuries.shortComment: Moss (concussion) does not have any injury designation ahead of Sunday's game against the Raiders, Aric DiLalla of the Broncos' official site reports.
injuries.longComment: Moss was a full participant in Friday's practice. The newly extended Broncos starter has cleared the NFL's five-step concussion protocol and is all set to suit up for Sunday's contest. The team's Week 10 bye helped Moss rest and recover from the injury he sustained during the Broncos' Week 9 win over the Panthers.

injuries.shortComment: Jones (hamstring) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Raiders, Aric DiLalla of the Broncos' official site reports.
injuries.longComment: Jones strung together three limited practices Week 11 prep, and he has a chance to return from a one-game absence due to a hamstring injury that he picked up in Week 8 against the Chiefs. JL Skinner figures to be the top candidate to start alongside Talanoa Hufanga at safety if Jones is not cleared to play against Las Vegas.

injuries.shortComment: Waddle (concussion) doesn't carry an injury designation for Sunday's game against the Raiders after practicing fully this week.
injuries.longComment: Waddle was limited to just 14 snaps and one catch for 22 yards before exiting the Broncos' Week 9 win over the Panthers with a concussion. Following a well-time Week 10 bye, Waddle has progressed through the NFL's concussion protocol, ensuring that Denver's top pass catcher -- who has recorded a 30/337/2 receiving line on 52 targets through nine contests -- will be available this weekend.

injuries.shortComment: Abrams-Draine (ankle) practiced in full Thursday.
injuries.longComment: The cornerback was a limited participant Wednesday. Abrams-Draine had to miss the Broncos' win over the Panthers in Week 9 ahead of the team's Week 10 bye. Now that he's had a week off to get healthy, he appears ready to play Sunday against Las Vegas.

injuries.shortComment: Prentice (concussion) was a full participant in Wednesday's practice.
injuries.longComment: It appears Prentice entered the league's concussion protocol following the Broncos' Week 9 win over the Panthers. He had additional time to recover courtesy of the Week 10 bye, so the veteran fullback should be available for Sunday's AFC West tilt against the Raiders.

injuries.shortComment: Singleton recorded six tackles (two solo) during the Broncos' 26-21 win over the Panthers in Week 9.
injuries.longComment: Singleton's six stops were a season low, but he still finished second on the Broncos in that category behind Jahdae Barron (eight). It's been a career year for Singleton, who is up to an NFL-leading 107 total tackles through nine regular-season games, which includes 2.0 sacks.

injuries.shortComment: Trautman caught two of three passes for 15 yards during the Broncos' 26-21 win over the Panthers on Sunday.
injuries.longComment: Trautman failed to record a catch across six games between Weeks 2 and 7, but he has logged two receptions in each of his two outings. His 41 offensive snaps ended up being ahead of fellow tight end Evan Engram (38), although the latter has been more involved in the Broncos' offensive game plan than Trautman. The Broncos' next game takes place in Week 11 against the Raiders on Sunday, Nov. 22.

injuries.shortComment: Mims caught one of two targets for zero yards, added a five-yard carry and returned three punts for 22 yards during the Broncos' 26-21 win over the Panthers on Sunday.
injuries.longComment: Nineteen of Mims' 24 snaps came on offense, although he logged only two touches in the process. He hasn't seen more than four targets in a game this season, with most of his output coming on special teams as a returner on both kickoffs and punts. The Broncos are on a bye for Week 10, so their next game will take place in Week 11 against the Raiders on Sunday, Nov. 22

injuries.shortComment: Franklin brought in three of four targets for 31 yards during the Broncos' 26-21 win over the Panthers on Sunday.
injuries.longComment: Franklin drew a 27-yard pass interference penalty on the Broncos' second offensive play of the game, but the third-year wide receiver didn't log his first catch until early in the fourth quarter. He has operated in a rotational role for most of the season, and even with Jaylen Waddle in the league's concussion protocol, Franklin will likely maintain that workload following the Broncos' Week 10 bye.

injuries.shortComment: Engram caught four of five targets for 33 yards in Sunday's 26-21 win over the Panthers.
injuries.longComment: The four catches matched Engram's season high, and his 33 yards were his most since Week 5. It goes without saying, but Engram is well off the fantasy radar at tight end. He has 17 catches for 169 yards and one touchdown through nine games, averaging a career-low 18.8 yards per contest.

injuries.shortComment: Lutz went 2-for-2 on both his field-goal attempts and extra-point tries during Denver's win over Carolina on Sunday.
injuries.longComment: Lutz's field-goal tries were good from 26 and 48 yards. The 32-year-old has now converted 16 of his 19 field-goal attempts and all 16 of his extra-point tries across nine appearances this season.

injuries.shortComment: Dobbins rushed four times for 18 yards and caught his only target for four yards during Sunday's 26-21 win over Carolina.
injuries.longComment: Dobbins saw 13 fewer carries than rookie running back Jonah Coleman (17-57-1) in the game. The four rushes were a season low for Dobbins, and he figures to continue to operate as the team's No. 2 option in the backfield moving forward.

injuries.shortComment: Bryant caught four of five targets for 56 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 26-21 win over Carolina.
injuries.longComment: Bryant was activated from IR on Saturday after recovering from an ankle injury, and he came up big late in Sunday's contest, hauling in a 26-yard TD strike from Bo Nix with less than six minutes left in the fourth quarter for what proved to be the game-winning score. The second-year wideout's clutch play came after Jaylen Waddle (concussion) had left the game, and if a Week 10 bye doesn't give him enough time to recover, Bryant could see an elevated role in Week 11 against the Raiders.

injuries.shortComment: Sutton caught five of nine targets for 45 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 26-21 win over the Panthers.
injuries.longComment: The five grabs and nine targets led the Broncos on the day, but Pat Bryant just edged him out for the receiving yards lead. The highlight of Sutton's solid performance was a three-yard TD from Bo Nix in the first quarter, as none of his receptions went for longer than 12 yards. Denver gets a well-timed bye in Week 10, but if Jaylen Waddle (concussion) isn't cleared to play on the other side of it, Sutton could see bigger volume in Week 11 against the Raiders. On the season, the long-time Bronco sports a 25-266-2 line on 46 targets through nine games.

injuries.shortComment: Coleman carried the ball 17 times for 57 yards and a touchdown and caught all four of his targets for 31 yards in Sunday's 26-21 win over the Panthers.
injuries.longComment: The rookie has seized control of the lead-back role for the Broncos, with his 21 touches dwarfing J.K. Dobbins' five, and Coleman's nine-yard TD run early in the fourth quarter put his team in the lead for good. Coleman has piled up 261 scrimmage yards and two rushing touchdowns over the last three games, and there's no reason to think his role will shrink on the other side of a Week 10 bye.

injuries.shortComment: Nix completed 25 of 37 passes for 237 yards and two touchdowns with one interception in Sunday's 26-21 win over the Panthers. He added two rushing yards on five carries.
injuries.longComment: The Broncos had the home team right where they wanted them heading into the fourth quarter -- holding a lead -- and Nix worked his usual magic over the final 15 minutes, leading back-to-back touchdown drives capped by a nine-yard TD run from Jonah Coleman and a 26-yard strike to Pat Bryant for what proved to be the winning score. Nix did throw his first INT since Week 3 in the win, but he heads into a Week 10 bye with Denver riding a five-game win streak that has taken it to the top of the AFC West.

injuries.shortComment: Tillman is active for Sunday's game against the Panthers, Aric DiLalla of the team's official site reports.
injuries.longComment: Tillman was on the injury report ahead of the Week 9 meeting with Carolina due to a hamstring issue. However, he will avoid his second absence of the 2026 campaign. The 28-year-old has appeared in seven games for the Broncos this season, amassing 19 total tackles (10 solo).

injuries.shortComment: The Lions placed Mays (ankle) on injured reserve Saturday.
injuries.longComment: Mays missed the Lions' two prior games due to an ankle injury that he sustained against the Vikings in Week 8. His placement on IR means he's required to miss at least the next four games, so the earliest he can return is Week 15 against Minnesota. Juice Scruggs figures to be the Lions' starting center for as long as Mays is sidelined.

injuries.shortComment: Reed (hip) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Buccaneers.
injuries.longComment: Reed was a limited participant in all three practices during Week 11 prep while tending to a hip injury, which has prevented him from playing in each of the Lions' last two games. Per Jeremy  Reisman of PrideofDetroit.com on Wednesday, Reed did not express optimism that he would face Tampa Bay. Khalil Dorsey (ankle) and Ennis Rakestraw (shoulder) are both also listed as questionable, which leaves Rock Ya-Sin, Roger McCreary and Christian Izien as the only healthy cornerbacks on the Lions' 53-man roster heading into the weekend.

injuries.shortComment: Vaki (ankle) is questionable for Sunday's game against the Buccaneers.
injuries.longComment: If Vaki is unable to play against Tampa Bay, Jacob Saylors would move up to RB2 status, but Jahmyr Gibbs would have a chance to see an even bigger share of the backfield opportunities in that scenario.

injuries.shortComment: McCreary recorded six tackles (four solo) and two pass defenses (including an interception) during the Lions' 35-10 win over the Patriots in Week 10 in Munich.
injuries.longComment: McCreary recorded his first interception of the season in Week 10, when he jumped in front of a pass from Tommy DeVito -- who took over under center for the Patriots after Drake Maye injured his ankle in the first quarter -- that was intended for Mack Hollins, although the Lions' offense couldn't convert the takeaway into points. McCreary is up to 38 tackles (28 solo), including 1.0 sacks, 10 pass defenses and one forced fumble across nine regular-season games.

injuries.shortComment: The Lions activated Joseph (knee) from the reserve/PUP list Wednesday.
injuries.longComment: Joseph was a full participant in his return to the active roster Wednesday. The free safety is set to make his 2026 debut in Week 11 against the Buccaneers, finally reuniting with strong safety Brian Branch after both spent lengthy periods on the Lions' reserve lists.

injuries.shortComment: The Lions placed Hutchinson (knee) on injured reserve Wednesday.
injuries.longComment: Hutchinson's move to IR was merely a formality after he was diagnosed with a torn ACL in his right knee following his early exit from this past Sunday's 35-10 win over the Patriots in Munich. The No. 2 overall pick in the 2022 NFL Draft has now succumbed to two season-ending injuries through his first five years in the league, after a fractured tibia and fibula in his left leg cut short his 2024 campaign.

injuries.shortComment: Conklin went without a target while playing 22 of the Lions' 71 offensive snaps in Sunday's 35-10 win over the Patriots in Munich.
injuries.longComment: A healthy inactive for two of the Lions' first four games of the season, Conklin has now suited up for five consecutive contests. However, the veteran tight end has been handling a limited role, logging less than one-third of the offensive snaps in any of his seven appearances on the season while compiling a 2-11-0 receiving line on three targets.

injuries.shortComment: Saylors rushed twice for nine yards while adding 26 yards as a kick returner during Sunday's 35-10 win over the Patriots.
injuries.longComment: Saylors played six snaps on offense while serving as a No. 3 option behind Jahmyr Gibbs and Sione Vaki in the backfield. Saylors was on the field for 20 snaps with the special-teams unit, and he'll continue to be primarily a special-teams asset in Week 11 against the Buccaneers.

injuries.shortComment: Wright caught both of his targets for 11 yards during the Lions' 35-10 win over the Patriots on Sunday in Munich.
injuries.longComment: Wright tied season highs in both receiving yards and catches during Sunday's win, and his 39 snaps on offense were second-most among Lions tight ends behind Sam LaPorta (56). Wright has accumulated seven catches on eight target for 42 yards across nine regular-season games, and he's mostly served as a blocking tight end on the Lions' offense.

injuries.shortComment: LaPorta caught one of four targets for 16 yards in Sunday's 35-10 win over the Patriots in Munch.
injuries.longComment: The Lions didn't need to throw it much, as Drake Maye (ankle) got knocked out of the game for the Patriots early, and LaPorta simply didn't get many chances to make an impact. It was the worst performance of the season for the fourth-year tight end, but LaPorta's gone four straight games without reaching 40 receiving yards or getting into the end zone. He'll try to break out in Week 11 against the Buccaneers.

injuries.shortComment: Williams caught four of seven targets for 50 yards in Sunday's 35-10 win over the Patriots in Munich.
injuries.longComment: Amon-Ra St. Brown and Jahmyr Gibbs monopolized the Lions' offense on the day, scoring four of the team's five TDs, and there wasn't much production left over for Williams. The fifth-year wideout has topped 50 receiving yards just three times this season, and he'll take a 32-518-5 line on 51 targets through nine games into a Week 11 battle with the Buccaneers.

injuries.shortComment: St. Brown caught four of five targets for 98 yards and two touchdowns in Sunday's 35-10 win over the Patriots in Munich.
injuries.longComment: The Lions didn't need to throw it much, as Drake Maye (ankle) got knocked out of the game for the Patriots early. St. Brown took full advantage of the volume he saw however, scoring on a 56-yard catch and run in the first quarter and then taking another short pass from Jared Goff and turning it into a 28-yard TD in the third. It was St. Brown's third multi-TD game of the season but his first since Week 2, and he'll take a 65-755-7 line on 91 targets through nine games into a Week 11 clash with the Buccaneers.

injuries.shortComment: Bates made all five of his PATs in the Lions' 35-10 win over the Patriots on Sunday in Munich.
injuries.longComment: Bates did not attempt a field goal in the contest. He remains 16-for-17 on field-goal attempts and moves to 29-for-29 on PATs through nine regular-season games in 2026.

injuries.shortComment: TeSlaa caught two of five targets for 19 yards and a touchdown during the Lions' 35-10 win over the Patriots on Sunday in Munich. He also recorded a tackle.
injuries.longComment: It was a quiet day for TeSlaa, with the Lions' offense being powered by usual suspects Amon-Ra St. Brown and Jahmyr Gibbs, with the latter duo combining for four touchdowns (three receiving, one rushing). TeSlaa was the other Lions player to find the end zone, which took place early in the second quarter on a 12-yard touchdown pass from Jared Goff. It was the first touchdown catch of the season for TeSlaa, who found the end zone six times across 17 regular-season games during his rookie campaign in 2025. He has been the Lions' distant WR3 behind St. Brown and Jameson Williams, and that shouldn't change ahead of the team's Week 11 tilt against the Buccaneers on Nov. 22.

injuries.shortComment: Gibbs carried the ball 22 times for 153 yards and two touchdowns while catching seven of eight targets for 99 yards in Sunday's 35-10 win over the Patriots.
injuries.longComment: Drake Maye (ankle) got knocked out of the game early for New England, setting the stage for the rout, and Gibbs took full advantage as he set new season highs in receiving yards and scrimmage yards. It's the fourth time in 2026 that the star RB has topped 150 rushing yards, and his fourth game with multiple TDs. Gibbs has amassed 1,384 scrimmage yards and 13 total touchdowns through nine contests as he gets ready to face a stingy Buccaneers run defense in Week 11.

injuries.shortComment: Goff completed 20 of 31 passes for 303 yards and three touchdowns with two interceptions in Sunday's 35-10 win over the Patriots in Munich. He added three yards on his only carry.
injuries.longComment: A potential barn burner versus Drake Maye never materialized when the New England quarterback left the game early with an ankle injury, but Goff and the Detroit offense still held up their end of the bargain. Two of Goff's TDs went to Amon-Ra St. Brown, including a 56-yard catch-and-run score in the first quarter, while Isaac TeSlaa also hauled in a 12-yard score in the second. Goff will take an 18:4 TD:INT through nine games into a Week 11 clash at home against the Buccaneers.

injuries.shortComment: Wonnum (concussion) does not carry an injury designation into Sunday's game against the Patriots in Munich, Nolan Bianchi of The Detroit News reports.
injuries.longComment: Wonnum entered the league's concussion protocol during the Lions' Week 8 win over the Vikings. He was held out of Detroit's Week 9 win over Miami, but Wonnum has cleared protocol after passing an evaluation by an independent neurologist. His return bolsters the Lions' rotational depth on the defensive line alongside Aidan Hutchinson, Tyler Lacy and Derrick Moore.

injuries.shortComment: Cisse (ribs) practiced Saturday, Bill Huber of SI.com reports.
injuries.longComment: Cisse was forced out of last Sunday's loss to the Vikings, but his injury isn't considered serious, and it sounds like the cornerback will be ready to go for Wednesday's game against the Rams.

injuries.shortComment: Franklin (shin) participated in practice Saturday, Bill Huber of SI.com reports.
injuries.longComment: Franklin has missed four straight games with a fractured shin, but his participation in practice Saturday gives him a chance to play in Wednesday's Thanksgiving Eve game against the Rams. Isaiah McDuffie and Ty'Ron Hopper have been manning linebacker for Green Bay.

injuries.shortComment: Moore (ankle) participated in practice Saturday, Bill Huber of SI.com reports.
injuries.longComment: Moore made his return from injured reserve last Sunday against the Vikings but played just three special-teams snaps before aggravating his existing ankle injury. It's not believed to be a serious issue, and Moore has a chance to play Wednesday versus the Rams.

injuries.shortComment: Parsons (knee) participated in practice Saturday, Bill Huber of SI.com reports.
injuries.longComment: Parsons is expected to officially practice in all three sessions leading up to Wednesday night's Thanksgiving Eve game against the Rams, and he'll have a shot to make his 2026 season debut against Los Angeles. More will be known early next week. The Packers are currently on their bye.

injuries.shortComment: Jacobs (finger) is participating in Saturday's practice session, Bill Huber of SI.com reports.
injuries.longComment: Head coach Matt LaFleur didn't sound optimistic about Jacobs' chances of playing against the Rams on Wednesday, but the veteran running back will "have a chance to prove" that he can suit up for that contest over the next few days at practice, per Matt Schneidman of The Athletic. Weston Hodkiewicz of the Packers' official site relayed that Jacobs was spotted at Saturday's practice with a "claw-like cast" on his fingers. In the event that Jacobs doesn't play Wednesday, the Packers would enter the game with a backfield of Kaleb Johnson, MarShawn Lloyd and Chris Brooks.

injuries.shortComment: Williams logged eight tackles (two solo) and a pass defense during the Packers' 30-10 loss to the Vikings in Week 10.
injuries.longComment: Williams played every single defensive snap in Week 10 and finished tied for the second-most tackles on the Packers behind Isaiah McDuffie (10). Williams has recorded at least eight stops in three of his last four outings and is up to 84 tackles (50 solo), including 1.0 sacks, eight pass defenses (including three interceptions) and a fumble recovery through 10 regular-season games. He is well on track to surpass 100 tackles for a second consecutive year.

injuries.shortComment: McKinney registered six tackles (three solo) and an interception during the Packers' 30-10 loss to the Vikings in Week 10.
injuries.longComment: McKinney picked off a deep pass from Kirk Cousins intended for Tai Felton late in the second quarter, although the Packers' offense failed to turn that takeaway into points before the end of the half. McKinney has three picks over his last two outings and is up to a league-leading six interceptions. The veteran safety is up to 44 tackles (25 solo), including 1.0 sacks, and seven pass defenses through 10 regular-season games.

injuries.shortComment: Williams caught two passes for 27 yards on two targets in Sunday's 30-10 loss to the Vikings.
injuries.longComment: As he's been doing since making his season debut in Week 6, Williams operated as the Packers' third receiver against Minnesota. He logged 20 offensive snaps and ran 16 routes on 37 dropbacks. Williams has yet to hit 50 receiving yards in any of his five games this season and has no real fantasy appeal in 12-team fantasy leagues. He's well behind Matthew Golden, Christian Watson and Tucker Kraft in the order for touches and targets.

injuries.shortComment: Brooks rushed two times for one yard and caught his only target for two yards in Sunday's 30-10 loss to the Vikings.
injuries.longComment: It was Brooks' first action since Week 4 after spending five games on injured reserve with a high-ankle sprain. With Josh Jacobs (finger) inactive against Minnesota, Brooks led the backfield with 26 offensive snaps in Week 10, but it didn't translate to touches or opportunities to handle the football. With Kaleb Johnson and MarShawn Lloyd also involved, it's difficult to pinpoint any of these three as reliable fantasy options despite Jacobs' absence.

injuries.shortComment: Sturdivant caught two passes for 37 yards and a touchdown on four targets in Sunday's 30-10 loss to the Vikings.
injuries.longComment: After Green Bay was shut out in the first half, Sturdivant's first career touchdown came in the third quarter from 32 yards out, and it went down as the Packers' lone touchdown of the afternoon. Sturdivant played just nine offensive snaps as the fourth receiver and would need more than one injury ahead of him on the depth chart to be relevant in fantasy.

injuries.shortComment: Smack went 1-for-2 on field-goal attempts and made his only extra-point try during Sunday's 30-10 loss to the Vikings.
injuries.longComment: Smack pushed a 53-yard field-goal try wide right in the first quarter before later converting a 40-yard attempt in the final seconds of the third quarter. The rookie has now gone 15-for-21 on field-goal tries, including 3-for-4 from 50-plus yards, while making 21 of 24 extra-point attempts over 10 contests so far during the 2026 campaign.

injuries.shortComment: Taylor completed one of two pass attempts for three yards in Sunday's 30-10 loss to the Vikings.
injuries.longComment: Down 20 points with four minutes remaining in the fourth quarter and with starting quarterback Jordan Love having already taken eight sacks on the afternoon, the Packers opted to turn to Taylor to direct the offense for their final possession of the day. All three of Taylor's appearances on the season have now come late in blowout wins or losses, and his opportunities are likely to remain limited to garbage-time situations so long as Love is healthy.

injuries.shortComment: Lloyd finished Sunday's loss to Minnesota with 13 yards on four carries while catching all three of his targets for 26 yards.
injuries.longComment: With Josh Jacobs (finger) sidelined, Green Bay turned to the trio of Lloyd, Kaleb Johnson and Chris Brooks in the backfield. Johnson led the team with 10 carries and 42 total yards despite not getting any targets. Meanwhile, Lloyd turned his seven touches into 39 yards, and Brooks tallied just three yards on his three touches. Green Bay is on bye during the coming week, but Jacobs may still miss the team's next game, which will take place Wednesday, Nov. 25, against the Rams. If that's the case, Lloyd will likely work as part of a shared backfield again, which isn't great for his fantasy outlook.

injuries.shortComment: Johnson carried the ball 10 times for 42 yards in Sunday's 30-10 loss to the Vikings.
injuries.longComment: The former Steeler led the Packers' backfield in totes and rushing yards, with MarShawn Lloyd chipping in 39 scrimmage yards on seven touches. Johnson has produced modest but decent numbers over the last two games, averaging a 4.6 YPC on 24 carries as the top early-down option for Green Bay. Josh Jacobs (finger) could return after the team's Week 11 bye, but if he isn't cleared, Johnson could find himself atop the depth chart again in Week 12 against the Rams.

injuries.shortComment: Kraft caught one of four targets for 19 yards in Sunday's 30-10 loss to the Vikings.
injuries.longComment: The tight end's numbers reflected how much time his quarterback had to look downfield, as Jordan Love got sacked eight times in the rout. Kraft has been held to just one catch in back-to-back games, and he heads into a Week 11 bye with a 37-370-3 line on 56 targets through 10 games, with the Rams as the next opponent on the horizon in Week 12.

injuries.shortComment: Golden caught five of nine targets for 70 yards in Sunday's 30-10 loss to the Vikings.
injuries.longComment: The second-year wideout was the only Packer to have much success on offense, leading the team in catches, targets and receiving yards. Golden has reached 70 yards in three straight games and five of the last six, and he heads into a Week 11 bye with a 58-853-5 line on 101 targets through 10 contests. His next chance to add to those numbers will come in Week 12 against the Rams.

injuries.shortComment: Watson caught three of five targets for 37 yards in Sunday's 30-10 loss to Minnesota.
injuries.longComment: The Packers' passing game was stifled as the Vikings sacked Jordan Love eight times, giving him little time to find receivers like Watson. The 37 yards were a season low for the fifth-year wideout, while the three grabs tied for his lowest volume of 2026. Watson will take a 52-916-7 line on 79 targets through 10 contests into a Week 11 bye before facing the Rams in Week 12.

injuries.shortComment: Love completed 17 of 27 passes for 220 yards and a touchdown with an interception in Sunday's 30-10 loss to the Vikings.
injuries.longComment: The 28-year-old QB came into the game having been sacked just 17 times in his first nine games of the season, but Minnesota brought Love down eight times Sunday. Despite that onslaught, he was able to find J. Michael Sturdivant for a 32-yard TD in the third quarter to salvage his line slightly. It was the first time since Week 6 that Love had failed to throw multiple touchdowns, and just the second time all season. He'll get a Week 11 bye to heal up from Sunday's pummeling before facing Myles Garrett and the Rams in Week 12.

injuries.shortComment: Melton (thigh) has been ruled out for the rest of Sunday's game against the Vikings, Rob Demovsky of ESPN.com reports.
injuries.longComment: Melton exited Sunday's game because of a thigh injury, and he will not be cleared to return to the contest. Skyy Moore (ankle) will also not return, so Savion Williams and Matthew Golden will operate as the top return options on kickoffs and punts.

injuries.shortComment: Glover (knee) is active for Sunday's game against the Vikings, Mike Spofford of the Packers' official site reports.
injuries.longComment: Glover's practice reps were limited during Week 10 prep due to a knee injury that prevented him from playing against the Patriots in Week 9. The third-year pro was cleared by medical staff to play Sunday, and he should reclaim his starting role at right guard from Laken Tomlinson.

injuries.shortComment: Van Ness (back) is active for Sunday's game against the Vikings.
injuries.longComment: Van Ness upgraded to limited in Friday's practice while dealing with a back injury. The weakside linebacker has recovered enough to suit up for Sunday's contest against a Vikings team that is also fighting for the NFC North title.

injuries.shortComment: Bullard (ankle) is active for Sunday's game against the Vikings.
injuries.longComment: Bullard was upgraded to a limited participant in Friday's practice and is questionable ahead of Sunday's contest. The starting slot cornerback is all set to suit up, seemingly having overcome his ankle injury in time for a heavyweight NFC North bout with the Vikings.

injuries.shortComment: Stewart played 17 special-teams snaps in the Texans' 26-3 win over the Colts on Thursday night.
injuries.longComment: With the return of Reed Blankenship to the starting lineup, Stewart was relegated to special teams. The strong safety played 17 snaps but did not appear in the box score.

injuries.shortComment: To'oTo'o accumulated six tackles (four solo) in the Texans' 26-3 win over the Colts on Thursday night.
injuries.longComment: To'oTo'o played 100 percent of the Texans' defensive snaps for the second straight week. The linebacker was on the field for all 48 plays, logging four solo tackles in the effort.

injuries.shortComment: Anderson logged five tackles (two solo), including 1.0 sacks, during the Texans' 26-3 win over the Colts on Thursday night.
injuries.longComment: Anderson extended his NFL sacks lead to 11.5 in Thursday's contest. The pass rusher is amassing another strong season to contend for Defensive Player of the Year. Anderson finished 2025 with 12.0 sacks and is set to surpass that personal record this season.

injuries.shortComment: Moreau brought in his lone target for eight yards during the Texans' 26-3 win over the Colts on Thursday.
injuries.longComment: Moreau's 30 offensive snaps were second among Texans tight ends behind Dalton Schultz's 34, yet it was Marlin Klein who led the position group with four catches (on as many targets) for 24 yards, including a 13-yard touchdown pass from C.J. Stroud late in the third quarter. Moreau is up to a 12-80-3 receiving line on 15 targets through 10 regular-season games and has caught one pass or zero in five of those contests. He doesn't have much fantasy appeal unless Schultz were to miss time.

injuries.shortComment: Fairbairn made his sole field-goal attempt and all three PATs in the Texans' 26-3 win over the Colts on Thursday night.
injuries.longComment: Fairbairn's only field goal of the night was a 27-yarder with 15 seconds remaining in the first half. The kicker is 20-for-21 on field-goal attempts and 27-for-27 on PATs over 10 regular-season games so far in 2026.

injuries.shortComment: Demercado rushed five times for 33 yards and caught both of his targets for minus-four yards in Thursday night's 26-3 win over the Colts.
injuries.longComment: With Woody Marks (concussion) inactive, Demercado played the complementary role behind lead back David Montgomery, who rushed 26 times for 107 yards in his return from a multi-week groin injury. Demercado was picked up off waivers from Dallas last month.

injuries.shortComment: Boutte's hip injury he suffered in Thursday night's win over the Colts doesn't appear to be serious, Aaron Wilson of KPRC 2 Houston reports.
injuries.longComment: The wideout had one of his more productive games of the season before being injured, as he caught both of his targets for 40 yards and a touchdown. His 40 yards were the second-most he's produced in a game this season. Boutte is up to 21 grabs for 359 yards and three touchdowns on 31 targets across 10 games in 2026.

injuries.shortComment: Hutchinson caught two of three targets for 13 yards in Thursday night's 26-3 win over the Colts.
injuries.longComment: Hutchinson played 54 of 66 offensive snaps, second at wide receiver on the team behind Nico Collins' 59, and the former has been operating as the Texans' WR2 in terms of playing time for the last several weeks. By not scoring a touchdown Thursday night, Hutchinson snapped his personal three-game touchdown streak. For the season, he has 30 catches for 358 yards and three scores on 57 targets. He's on pace to set new career highs across the board.

injuries.shortComment: Klein secured all four targets for 24 yards and a touchdown in the Texans' 26-3 win over the Colts on Thursday.
injuries.longComment: Klein surprisingly outpaced veteran position mates Dalton Schultz and Foster Moreau on the night, and the rookie second-round pick, whose only other career reception coming in was a 16-yard grab in Week 1, added his first career touchdown on a 13-yard catch in the third quarter. Given Klein had been a complete non-factor coming into the night, it's difficult to predict whether Thursday's production will have any carryover to a Week 12 home matchup against the Ravens on Sunday, Nov. 29.

injuries.shortComment: Schultz brought in his only target for 11 yards in the Texans' 26-3 win over the Colts on Thursday.
injuries.longComment: Schultz had a minimal role on a night when C.J. Stroud threw for a modest 194 yards and recorded completions to nine different targets. The veteran tight end now has consecutive one-catch, 11-yard tallies after recording multiple receptions in each of his first eight games of the season, and Schultz's production will remain hard to trust heading into a Week 12 home matchup against the Ravens on Sunday, Nov. 29.

injuries.shortComment: Dell secured three of four targets for 27 yards in the Texans' 26-3 win over the Colts on Thursday.
injuries.longComment: The speedy wideout finished tied for second in receptions for the Texans on a night when C.J. Stroud recorded completions to nine different targets overall. Dell has played an effective complementary role since making his return from a gruesome 2024 knee injury in Week 7, as he now has an 11-196-1 line and four catches of 20-plus yards across 18 targets heading into a Week 12 home matchup against the Ravens on Sunday, Nov. 29.

injuries.shortComment: Stroud completed 21 of 26 passes for 194 yards with three touchdowns and one interception and rushed six times for 27 yards in the Texans' 26-3 win over the Colts on Thursday.
injuries.longComment: Stroud's night got off to a rocky start when a deflected pass resulted in an interception on the Texans' opening drive, but the red-hot signal-caller was near perfect from that point forward. The 2023 first-round pick went on to toss three touchdown passes for the second straight game and multiple scores for the fifth consecutive contest overall. Stroud connected with Nico Collins (42 yards), Kayshon Boutte (24 yards) and Marlin Klein (13 yards) for his trio of scoring strikes, and he'll take a sparkling 22:4 TD:INT into a Week 12 home matchup against the Ravens on Sunday, Nov. 29.

injuries.shortComment: Collins secured three of five targets for 58 yards and a touchdown in the Texans' 26-3 win over the Colts on Thursday.
injuries.longComment: Facing a Colts defense down both Sauce Gardner (calf) and Charvarius Ward (knee), Collins looked primed for a big night early when he recorded a 42-yard touchdown grab to cap off Houston's second possession. However, C.J. Stroud proceeded to spread the ball around to nine different targets overall, leading to Collins tying his second-lowest reception tally and posting his third-lowest yardage total of the season. However, the star wideout did extend his touchdown streak to three games, and he'll next take aim at what has been an inconsistent Ravens secondary in a Week 12 home matchup on Sunday, Nov. 29.

injuries.shortComment: Montgomery rushed 26 times for 107 yards and brought in three of four targets for 17 yards in the Texans' 26-3 win over the Colts on Thursday.
injuries.longComment: Making his return from a four-game absence due to a groin injury, Montgomery functioned as the clear lead back with Woody Marks (concussion) unavailable. The former put together the best rushing yardage total of his brief Texans tenure, handling his highest number of carries since Week 4 of his 2023 debut campaign with the Lions. Montgomery also was encouragingly involved in a complementary role in the passing game, and he'll now have some extra time to recover from Thursday's workload ahead of a Week 12 home matchup against the Ravens on Sunday, Nov. 29. However, if Marks is able to clear concussion protocol ahead of that contest, Montgomery will see his touch count take a hit.

injuries.shortComment: Rutledge (stinger) was deemed questionable to return near the end of Thursday's 26-3 win against Indianapolis and didn't end up re-entering the game.
injuries.longComment: The Texans announced Rutledge's injury in the waning moments of the contest, but he had been in the medical tent well before that time. Febechi Nwaiwu took over at left guard following Rutledge's departure. With Houston not set to play again until Sunday, Nov. 29, against Baltimore, Rutledge will look to recover from the stinger in time to suit up.

injuries.shortComment: Brown (back) has returned to Thursday's game versus the Colts, Aaron Wilson of KPRC 2 Houston reports.
injuries.longComment: Brown left Thursday's contest after suffering a back injury, but he was able to check back in with the Texans' field goal team in the second quarter. With that said, veteran Braden Smith was still working as Houston's right tackle when the first half of Thursday's game ended.

injuries.shortComment: Rankins (ankle) is questionable to return to Thursday's game versus the Colts.
injuries.longComment: Rankins sustained an apparent ankle injury during the second quarter of Thursday's contest, and he was able to walk gingerly to the sideline under his own power. In his absence, rookie second-rounder Kayden McDonald figures to see an increase in snaps on the defensive line.

injuries.shortComment: Braswell has been ruled out for the remainder of Thursday's game versus the Colts with a knee injury.
injuries.longComment: Braswell suffered an injury in kick coverage on the opening kickoff and was promptly carted off the field with his right leg in an air cast, per James Boyd of The Athletic. The Texans will have to try to find a way to replace his production on special teams.

injuries.shortComment: Teller (back) is inactive for Thursday's game versus the Colts.
injuries.longComment: Teller was unavailable in Week 10 against the Browns due to an illness, and he'll be sidelined in Week 11 by a back injury. In his absence, rookie fourth-rounder Febechi Nwaiwu projects as the Texans' top option off the bench at guard.

injuries.shortComment: Hummel (groin) is active for Thursday Night Football against the Colts.
injuries.longComment: The linebacker suffered the injury in Week 1, returned for Week 10 and then carried a questionable tag into this contest, but he appears ready to play through the injury for the second consecutive game. Hummel logged two tackles (one solo) across 21 special-teams snaps against the Browns last week.

injuries.shortComment: Smith (hamstring) is active for Thursday night's game against the Colts.
injuries.longComment: The cornerback was activated from injured reserve earlier in the day Thursday and will be making his first appearance since Week 4. Smith played just seven defensive snaps across the first four games of the season.

injuries.shortComment: Boettcher recorded six tackles (three solo) during the Colts' 26-3 loss to the Texans on Thursday.
injuries.longComment: Boettcher finished Thursday's game tied for the fourth-most tackles on the Colts. The rookie fourth-rounder has started in each of Indianapolis' last three games, which has lined up with the absence of Akeem Davis-Gaither (knee, IR). Boettcher is up to 50 tackles (16 solo) through 11 regular-season games.

injuries.shortComment: Adebawore finished Thursday's 26-3 loss to the Texans with seven tackles (four solo), including 1.0 sacks.
injuries.longComment: Adebawore recorded his fifth sack of the season early in the third quarter, when he took down C.J. Stroud for a seven-yard loss. Adebawore has already set a career-high in sacks through 11 regular-season games and has accumulated 31 tackles (15 solo), one defense and a scoop-and-score in 2026.

injuries.shortComment: Haulcy logged nine tackles (four solo) and an interception during the Colts' 26-3 loss to the Texans on Thursday.
injuries.longComment: The rookie third-rounder recorded the first interception of his career in the first quarter, when a pass from C.J. Stroud intended for Nico Collins bounced off Haulcy's helmet, off the hands of Cam Bynum and into Haulcy's arms. The LSU product is up to 53 tackles (30 solo) and three pass defenses through 10 regular-season games.

injuries.shortComment: Allen posted 16 tackles (seven solo) during the Colts' 26-3 loss to the Texans on Thursday.
injuries.longComment: It was a busy night for the rookie second-rounder, who finished with a career-high in stops while logging double-digit tackles for the third time this season. Allen has 45 total tackles over his last four outings, and most of that extra playing time has come in the absence of Akeem Davis-Gaither (knee, IR).

injuries.shortComment: Watkins caught one of his three targets for 26 yards during the Colts' 26-3 loss to the Texans on Thursday night.
injuries.longComment: Watkins played just five offensive snaps for the Colts in Thursday night's game. Despite playing only 10 percent of the offensive snaps, Watkins totaled the third-highest yardage by Colts pass catchers on the night with his 26-yard grab. The reserve wide receiver could see an expanded role down the stretch as the Colts experiment with starting quarterback Anthony Richardson in what is all but a lost season.

injuries.shortComment: Dulin caught two of his four targets for 30 yards and assisted on two tackles on kick coverage during the Colts' 26-3 loss to the Texans on Thursday night.
injuries.longComment: Dulin played 22 offensive snaps and 10 special-teams snaps in the contest. The No. 4 wide receiver saw plenty of attention, catching 50 percent of his targets to accumulate the second-highest receiving yardage for the Colts, behind Anthony Gould's 48 yards.

injuries.shortComment: Burks was targeted three times for zero catches, had one kick return for 10 yards and made one tackle on kick coverage during the Colts' 26-3 loss to the Texans on Thursday night.
injuries.longComment: Burks was the No. 2 wide receiver for the Colts in the contest. Despite being targeted three times, the wide receiver could not haul in any passes from since-cut quarterback Daniel Jones. Burks played 32 offensive snaps and two special-teams snaps in the contest.

injuries.shortComment: Shrader went 1-for-3 on field-goal attempts during the Colts' 26-3 loss to the Texans on Thursday.
injuries.longComment: Shrader opened Thursday's scoring with a 34-yard field goal early in the first quarter. Those ended up being the only three points scored by the Colts, as Shrader missed a 56-yarder later in the quarter, and his 62-yarder in the second quarter was blocked by Logan Hall. It was the second time this season that Shrader has missed two kicks, and the third-year kicker now is 24-for-28 on field-goal attempts (including 9-for-12 on kicks from 50-plus yards) and 19-for-20 on extra-point tries through 11 regular-season games. His scoring potential figures to be lower for the rest of the season after the Colts waived Daniel Jones on Friday, which paves the way for Anthony Richardson to start under center in Week 12 against the Giants on Sunday, Nov. 29.

injuries.shortComment: The Colts announced Friday that Leonard will act as Anthony Richardson's backup at quarterback, Stephen Holder of ESPN.com reports.
injuries.longComment: The Colts released starting quarterback Daniel Jones after a disastrous 26-3 Thursday night loss to the Texans in Week 11. With Richardson in line to start moving forward, Leonard is the next QB up on the depth chart. The second-year pro has been with the Colts since 2025, when he played in five games, completing 39 of 67 attempts for 415 yards, two touchdowns and three interceptions. He also rushed six times for 27 yards and two touchdowns.

injuries.shortComment: Head coach Shane Steichen announced Friday that Richardson will be the Colts' starting quarterback moving forward after the team waived Daniel Jones.
injuries.longComment: Richardson made a cameo in Thursday's 26-3 loss at Houston, taking over for Jones for Indianapolis' final possession, but the former logged just a two-yard carry and two incompletions before the Texans ate up the final 6:50 of the contest. A 2023 first-round pick, Richardson himself hasn't started since Week 16 of the 2024 campaign, making just four brief appearances the past two seasons combined, but he'll have a chance to boost his value (or not) in the final year of his rookie contract.

injuries.shortComment: Giddens rushed one time for five yards and caught his lone target for 11 yards in Thursday night's 26-3 loss to the Texans.
injuries.longComment: With Seth McGowan (hamstring) exiting early with an injury, Giddens spelled Jonathan Taylor and played seven offensive snaps. Through three games this season, Giddens has rushed seven times for 48 yards and registered one catch for 11 yards. If McGowan's injury costs him time, Giddens figures to handle RB2 duties in his absence.

injuries.shortComment: Treadwell failed to catch his lone target in Thursday night's 26-3 loss to the Texans.
injuries.longComment: Treadwell played a position-high 40 of 50 offensive snaps but continues to run wind sprints in an offense that doesn't throw the ball down the field. Through 11 games this season, Treadwell has just 19 catches for 239 yards and one touchdown on 33 targets.

injuries.shortComment: Gould secured two of three targets for 48 yards in the Colts' 26-3 loss to the Texans on Thursday.
injuries.longComment: Gould was the rather unlikely leader in receiving yards for the Colts on the night, with a team-high 31-yard catch playing a big role in getting him there. The 2024 fifth-round pick has seen an expanded role in the wake of the trades of Josh Downs and Keenan Allen, and for as long as Alec Pierce (IR, heel) is sidelined, Gould could function as one of Indianapolis' top downfield threats for either Daniel Jones, Anthony Richardson or Riley Leonard.

injuries.shortComment: Warren brought in one of five targets for 22 yards in the Colts' 26-3 loss to the Texans on Thursday.
injuries.longComment: The talented tight end's production continued to suffer collateral damage from Daniel Jones' poor play, but Warren did provide a useful gain on his one catch. The 2025 first-round pick now has recorded Thursday's yardage total or less in three of the last four games, but Warren's outlook may change if Jones, who James Boyd of The Athletic reports head coach Shane Steichen wouldn't rule out demoting when asked after the game, is replaced by Anthony Richardson or Riley Leonard under center.

injuries.shortComment: Taylor rushed 11 times for 21 yards and brought in four of five targets for six yards in the Colts' 26-3 loss to the Texans on Thursday.
injuries.longComment: Taylor put some distance between himself and promising rookie backfield mate Seth McGowan in terms of workload, as the former outpaced his teammate in carries by an 11-3 margin, even with the latter exiting before halftime with a hamstring injury. However, the extra opportunity was a moot point, as Taylor couldn't find any space to operate as either a runner or receiver. Daniel Jones' mediocre play under center certainly isn't helping the ground attack's cause, and Taylor now has recorded less than 50 rushing yards in three of the last four contests. The star running back will have some additional time to prepare for a relatively favorable Week 12 home matchup against the Giants on Sunday, Nov. 29.

injuries.shortComment: McGowan (hamstring) has been ruled out for the rest of Thursday's game against the Texans, Jane Slater of NFL Network reports.
injuries.longComment: McGowan was injured just before halftime while returning a kickoff. He was deemed questionable to return at the beginning of the third quarter and subsequently was ruled out shortly thereafter. The rookie running back gained seven yards on three carries and caught his only target for one yard before exiting while adding 117 yards on three kickoff returns. Jonathan Taylor should continue to get most of the work at running back for the Colts for the rest of the game, and DJ Giddens should handle whatever backfield snaps that Taylor doesn't get.

injuries.shortComment: Rhodes (hamstring) is active for Thursday night's game against the Texans.
injuries.longComment: Rhodes is the team's long snapper. He missed last Sunday's win over Miami.

injuries.shortComment: Gardner (calf) is inactive for Thursday night's game against the Texans.
injuries.longComment: The cornerback has a history of calf issues, and the Colts, in the middle of a lost season, have no reason to push Gardner to play on a short week. With Charvarius Ward (knee) also out, Indy is down its top two cornerbacks against a pass-heavy Houston offense.

injuries.shortComment: Walley registered five tackles, a sack, a forced fumble and two pass breakups in Sunday's 24-22 win over the Dolphins.
injuries.longComment: The second-year defensive back was responsible for perhaps the biggest play of the game, as his strip sack of the Dolphins' Kyle McCord early in the third quarter led to a fumble recovery in the end zone by teammate Adetomiwa Adebawore. Walley was named the AFC Defensive Player of the Week for his big performance.

injuries.shortComment: Striggow (concussion) has been downgraded to out for Sunday's game against the Giants.
injuries.longComment: Striggow wasn't able to clear concussion protocol. He's appeared in nine games this season, logging 25 percent of the defensive snaps as a rotational defensive lineman.

injuries.shortComment: Green (forearm) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Giants.
injuries.longComment: Green has strung together six consecutive full practices since being designated to return from injured reserve Nov. 11. He's not quite ready to be activated from IR, so his next chance to play is Week 12 against the Titans on Sunday, Nov. 29. Green is in the final stages of his recovery from an elbow injury that he suffered in Week 1 against the Browns.

injuries.shortComment: Walker (ribs) does not have an injury designation for Sunday's game against the Giants.
injuries.longComment: Walker was a full participant in Friday's practice, and that was enough for the fifth-year defensive end to avoid an injury tag heading into Sunday's contest. The 2022 first-rounder has 22 tackles (10 solo), including 3.0 sacks, and two pass defenses through nine regular-season games.

injuries.shortComment: Johnson (ankle) does not carry an injury designation into Sunday's game against the Giants.
injuries.longComment: Johnson was a limited participant in all three Week 11 practices, but the 2023 fifth-rounder has done enough to avoid an injury tag ahead of Sunday's contest. Johnson has accumulated 40 tackles (23 solo), including 1.5 sacks, and one pass defense across eight regular-season games.

injuries.shortComment: Allen (hamstring) doesn't have an injury designation for Sunday's game against the Giants.
injuries.longComment: Allen has next to no fantasy appeal having played a total of 73 offensive snaps this season. In nine games, he's touched the ball a total of three times on offense.

injuries.shortComment: Rodriguez (hand) doesn't have an injury designation for Sunday's game against the Giants.
injuries.longComment: The backup running back has been dealing with the hand issue for weeks but continues to play through it. Rodriguez has averaged an underwhelming 3.9 yards per carry on 59 attempts this season, allowing Bhayshul Tuten to run away with lead-back duties in Jacksonville.

injuries.shortComment: Meyers (ankle) doesn't have an injury designation for Sunday's game against the Giants.
injuries.longComment: Meyers has been playing through the ankle injury for weeks, so his status was never in real doubt despite limited practices all week. The veteran wideout doesn't have a touchdown catch since Week 3 and has topped 65 receiving yards in a game just once all season. He's a low-floor, low-ceiling fantasy option.

injuries.shortComment: Tuten (ankle/foot) was present for the stretching portion of Friday's practice before moving to a side field, Ryan O'Halloran of The Florida Times-Union reports.
injuries.longComment: Tuten was deemed limited at practice Wednesday and then was a non-participant Thursday. It remains to be seen how the Jaguars classify his participation (or lack thereof) in Friday's session, with added clarity on that front set to arrive via the team's upcoming injury report.

injuries.shortComment: Jaguars head coach Liam Coen announced Wednesday that Hainsey (knee) is out for Sunday's game against the Giants, Ryan O'Halloran of The Florida Times-Union reports.
injuries.longComment: Jonah Monheim will draw the start at center in place of Hainsey, who exited this past Sunday's 40-23 win over the Titans due to a knee sprain, per Jeremy Fowler of ESPN.com. According to Fowler, Hainsey's knee injury isn't considered season-ending, but the veteran lineman is viewed as week-to-week and could be a candidate for injured reserve.

injuries.shortComment: Oluokun finished Sunday's 40-23 win over the Titans with 10 tackles (nine solo).
injuries.longComment: Sunday was the third time in nine regular-season games that Oluokun played every single defensive snap and the second time that he reached double-digit tackles. His nine solo stops were a season high and most in a game since Week 1 of the 2024 season. Oluokun has accumulated 44 tackles (30 solo), including 2.0 sacks, over his last five outings.

injuries.shortComment: Little went 4-for-4 on field-goal attempts and made all four of his PATs during Sunday's 40-23 win over the Titans.
injuries.longComment: Little was able to make four field-goal tries for the second straight week, converting attempts from 46, 48, 36 and 40 yards in the contest. The kicker has now gone 18-for-20 on field-goal attempts, including 4-for-6 from 50-plus yards, over nine contests during the 2026 campaign.

injuries.shortComment: Hunter caught both of his targets for 16 yards, recorded a three-yard carry and contributed five tackles (three solo) and an interception during the Jaguars' 40-23 win over the Titans on Sunday.
